notes:
v0.6.15: correct modem73 install method (github releases, not pipx).

The v0.6.14 release was wrong: it said `pipx install modem73` and
a `~/.local/bin → /usr/bin/modem73` symlink. That's incorrect.
modem73 ships as native `.deb`/`.rpm` binaries on
https://github.com/RFnexus/modem73/releases — there is no PyPI
package. The launcher scripts assume `/usr/bin/modem73` exists
with the v2.x TUI flag set.

Three docs fixed:
- BUILD.md Step 3: replaced `pipx install modem73` + symlink with
  `wget` of the pinned github release .deb + `sudo apt install -y
  /tmp/<deb>`. Pin to `MODEM73_VERSION="2.4.0"` for reproducibility.
- g90-image/IMAGE-PACKAGES.md: replaced the "modem73 is pipx" entry
  with a new "Native packages (github releases, NOT pipx)" section.
  Existing "Pipx venvs" section now contains only lxmf and
  reticulum-meshchatx (the actual pipx installs).
- docs/MODEM73.md "Install" section: rewritten with the correct
  github-releases install procedure. Removed the "Modem73 is on
  PyPI" claim. Added asset-name table for Pi 4 (armhf) vs Pi 5
  (arm64) vs Pi 4 in legacy 32-bit mode. Added the udev rule note.

Verified on g90digi: `/usr/bin/modem73` MD5 c0a90f51fa4094658017acf691b70bfe,
build banner "MODEM73 build Aug 29 2026 14:12:50" matches the
v2.4.0 github release publish time (2026-08-29T14:14:44Z). So the
already-installed modem73 on g90digi came from this release method,
not from pipx. The v0.6.14 recipe was wrong.

Asset note: the v2.4.0 release ships .debs for debian-12 (Raspberry
Pi OS Bookworm), debian-13, ubuntu-22.04, ubuntu-24.04, and armbian.
Pick the OS-major-version that matches. Raspberry Pi OS Bookworm
(bookworm = Debian 12) → debian-12_arm64.deb for Pi 5 / Pi 4 64-bit,
debian-12_armhf.deb for Pi 4 in legacy 32-bit mode.
